class.name: SpineTransformConstraintData
class.brief_description: Stores the setup pose for a transform constraint.
class.description: Stores the setup pose for a transform constraint. Runtime mix values live on [code]SpineTransformConstraintPose[/code]. Read the default values with [code]get_setup_pose()[/code]. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-transform-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this transform constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_offset_rotation
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone rotation.

method.name: get_offset_scale_x
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone scaleX.

method.name: get_offset_scale_y
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone scaleY.

method.name: get_offset_shear_y
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone shearY.

method.name: get_offset_x
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone X translation.

method.name: get_offset_y
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone Y translation.

method.name: get_setup_pose
method.description: Returns the setup pose for this transform constraint data.

method.name: get_source
method.description: The source bone whose world transform is copied to the constrained bones.

method.name: is_local_source
method.description: Returns whether the source transform is read in local space.

method.name: is_local_target
method.description: Returns whether offsets apply in local bone space instead of world space.
